sources.entry: 10. TextRazor - Text analysis API using AI.

summary.name: TextRazor
summary.one_liner: TextRazor is a text analysis API that extracts entities, keyphrases, topics, relations and semantic structure from documents, tweets and web pages.
use_cases: extract entities and keyphrases from documents
classify articles into IAB or IPTC topics
analyze tweets or web pages for topics
run text analysis on self-hosted infrastructure
summary.what_it_does:
TextRazor is an API for extracting meaning from text. It performs entity extraction, disambiguation and linking, keyphrase extraction, and automatic topic tagging and classification across 19 languages. It can classify content into the full IAB Content and IPTC Media Topic taxonomies. It also analyzes relations, typed dependencies between words, and synonyms to support semantic applications. The page says it is offered as a cloud or self-hosted text analysis infrastructure, drawing on a knowledgebase of real-life facts.</what_it_does>
